about.title: About
about.originP1: RTTTL Hub was born from a passion for FPV drones and a need for better tools to customize motor sounds. When I was tuning my flight controller's startup music, I found a lack of user-friendly editing tools and decided to build one myself.
about.originP2: What started as a personal project has grown into a comprehensive platform for browsing, creating, and sharing RTTTL ringtones.
about.purposeP1: RTTTL (Ring Tone Text Transfer Language) is a simple text format for describing monophonic melodies. It's widely used in retro ringtones, Arduino projects, ESC motor startup sounds (via flight controller firmware like Betaflight), and various embedded systems.
about.purposeP2: Whether you're tuning your flight controller, creating retro ringtones, or just exploring the nostalgic world of monophonic melodies, this platform is built for you.
about.techP1: The editor was inspired by modern DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) software, bringing familiar music production workflows to the world of chiptune and embedded systems.
about.techP2: It supports multi-track editing, real-time preview, syntax highlighting, and more, making the creative process intuitive and smooth.
about.communityP1: This is an open-source project. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to open an issue on
about.communityP3: We welcome contributions of all kinds — from new track collections to your own original compositions. Learn more about sharing on the
about.creatorP1: Hi, I'm Robby! I'm passionate about FPV drone flying and love exploring tech projects. If you're interested in FPV, feel free to follow my social channels and join the conversation.
about.creatorP2: Thank you for using RTTTL Hub. I hope this platform brings you help and joy.

privacy.scopeA: This policy applies to the information that we collect when you use RTTTL Hub as a visitor or registered user of our platform.
privacy.scopeB: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy describes what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding that data.
privacy.typeOfInfo: The type of information we collect
privacy.typeOfInfoA: We collect certain information about visitors and users of RTTTL Hub. The most common types of information include browser type, pages visited, and interaction patterns within the application.
privacy.localStorage: RTTTL Hub stores your preferences (theme, language), favorites, listened history, and user-created ringtones in your browser's local storage. This data never leaves your device unless you explicitly choose to share it.
privacy.analytics: We may use anonymized analytics to understand how visitors interact with RTTTL Hub, including which pages are visited most frequently and how users navigate through the application.

cookie.whatAreCookiesA: Cookies are small data files that are created when you browse a website, and which are sent to your computer or mobile device where they are stored by your web browser. Cookies serve a variety of functions, including remembering your preferences, keeping you signed in, and understanding how you use a website.
cookie.whatAreCookiesB: Similar technologies such as localStorage and sessionStorage serve comparable purposes on modern web applications. RTTTL Hub primarily uses localStorage to persist your preferences, favorites, and other settings.
cookie.whatAreCookiesC: All references to cookies in this policy also include references to localStorage, sessionStorage, and similar browser storage mechanisms.

audioExtract.title: Extracteur de mélodie IA
audioExtract.description: Sélectionnez un fichier audio à analyser. L'IA séparera les pistes, détectera les mélodies et les convertira au format RTTTL.
audioExtract.experimentalNotice: Ce modèle de reconnaissance IA est encore expérimental — nous travaillons activement à améliorer sa précision et sa vitesse. Pour de meilleurs résultats, essayez de fournir un fichier audio avec une piste vocale ou piano isolée et claire, ce qui facilite grandement l'analyse par le modèle. Si vous disposez déjà d'un fichier MIDI, nous vous recommandons vivement d'utiliser plutôt l'importation MIDI pour une expérience plus stable et plus précise.
